verdict.rationale: Medusa's own GitHub repo states that its core commerce modules are open-source and freely available. A community comment confirms the GitHub repo is MIT licensed, and the repo's OpenAPI spec also declares an MIT license. Independent lists name it as an open-source Shopify alternative. missing for 10: a first-party statement of the source-code license itself (e.g., the repo LICENSE file), and clarity on whether all components (e.g., the Enterprise/BYOC license tier) fall under the open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
